testcase.name: Scenario: Add and remove a ribbon command in quick access: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:406:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Add and remove a ribbon command in quick access ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And "Shell" is visible in the 3D Model Modify panel ✔ And "Shell" is absent from the quick-access toolbar ✔ When the user right-clicks "Shell" and selects "Add to Quick Access Toolbar" ✔ Then a Shell icon appears in the quick-access toolbar ✔ And "Shell" remains in the Modify panel ✔ When the user reopens the ribbon command context menu ✔ Then "Add to Quick Access Toolbar" is unavailable ✔ When the user right-clicks the added Shell icon in the quick-access toolbar ✔ Then its menu offers "Remove from Quick Access Toolbar" ✔ When the user selects "Remove from Quick Access Toolbar" ✔ Then the added Shell icon disappears from the toolbar ✔ And the ribbon command context menu offers "Add to Quick Access Toolbar" again
